coastal.title: Squamish mayoral candidates clash over property taxes, encampments in debate
coastal.description: More than 800 people watched the debate, which comes ahead of the Oct. 17 municipal election.

kamloops.title: For Salmon Arm voters, recreation facilities are a key municipal election issue
kamloops.description: Parents, coaches, athletes and active members of Salmon Arm's community say they will head to the polls with the issue of recreation facilities at the top of their minds.
